CMOS two-phase non-overlap clock generator
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VC clk 0 PULSE(0 3.3 10n 100p 100p 40n 100n)
XDUT vdd 0 clk a b astra_021_cmos_nonoverlap_clock
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec dead_rise range 1e-10 1e-9 unit=s
* @spec dead_fall range 1e-10 1e-9 unit=s
* @spec overlap range 0 0
* @spec phase_a range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec phase_b range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 20p 400n
let overlap=(v(a) gt 1.65)*(v(b) gt 1.65)
meas tran dead_rise TRIG v(b) VAL=1.65 FALL=1 TARG v(a) VAL=1.65 RISE=1
meas tran dead_fall TRIG v(a) VAL=1.65 FALL=1 TARG v(b) VAL=1.65 RISE=1 TD=40n
meas tran overlap MAX overlap FROM=1n TO=399n
meas tran phase_a FIND v(a) AT=30n
meas tran phase_b FIND v(b) AT=70n
write out.raw
quit
.endc
.end
